messages:
Ana (Marketing): Heads-up — co-marketing plan for CloudVendor marketplace listing + joint webinar. Goal: 250 registrants, ~30 MQLs. Need runbook, lead routing, and final benchmark copy. Who can own marketplace listing assets?
Maya (Partner Ops): I can take listing assets. Do we have final benchmark numbers to cite? Need 2–3 screenshots and a short technical blurb.
Kevin (Sales): We have a benchmark summary: up to 35% lower inference cost vs baseline and ~1.2s P50 latency in our test. I can export the CSV and a quick chart.
Luca (Growth): For the webinar format I suggest: 20m demo + 20m customer panel + 10m live Q&A. Proposed date: Wed May 14, 10am PT. Can we confirm availability?
Ana (Marketing): Can we lock May 14? +1. Also need landing page copy and gated benchmark. @Maya can you own lead mapping to HubSpot? Marketplace leads should map to pipeline 'marketplace_inbound'.
Maya (Partner Ops): Yep. I'll set up the webhook -> HubSpot form mapping and create a dedicated 'CloudVendor Marketplace' campaign. Need example webhook payload from them.
Kevin (Sales): Sample webhook payload (they'll POST JSON):
```
{
  "lead_email": "jane@acme.com",
  "company": "Acme Corp",
  "product_interested": "Redwood Inference - CloudVendor Listing",
  "referrer": "cloudvendor_marketplace",
  "utm": {"source":"cloudvendor","campaign":"cloudsync-launch"}
}
```
Use that to map fields to HubSpot.
deploy-bot: webinar-lp-v1 deployed to staging at 1766234600 — preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/webinars/cloudsync
Ana (Marketing): Run of show: 1) Quick welcome (3m) 2) Benchmark highlights (7m) 3) Live demo (15m) 4) Customer panel (20m) 5) Q&A (10m) 6) CTA / next steps (5m). CTA: request dedicated trial or schedule demo. Marketing to prep social snippets and gated benchmark PDF.
Luca (Growth): I'll produce 3 hero social posts + 5 short snippets for partners to syndicate. Proposed subject line A/B for emails: A) "How we cut inference cost by up to 35%" B) "Reduce LLM latency & cost — Redwood + CloudVendor". Thoughts?
Kevin (Sales): Legal flagged raw perf numbers in broad marketing. Suggest copy: 'up to 35% lower cost in our benchmark' + link to gated detailed results. That should be compliant.
Maya (Partner Ops): Noted. I'll gate the benchmark behind the LP form and set HubSpot to populate an internal property 'gated_benchmark_downloaded' true/false. Then route any MQLs to Sales queue 'CloudVendor Partners'.
Ana (Marketing): Action items and deadlines: - Maya: marketplace assets + lead mapping + webhook test (due May 2) - Luca: LP + social assets + email lines (due May 2) - Kevin: benchmark artifact + one customer speaker confirmation (due Apr 28) - Ana: host, comms calendar, partner outreach (due May 2). Please add blockers here.
Luca (Growth): I'll need the hero screenshot asset and benchmark chart SVG from Kevin by Apr 26 to hit deadlines.
Kevin (Sales): Will deliver chart + CSV by Apr 25. Re: panelist — pinging Acme contact now.
Ana (Marketing): Great. If anyone needs copy tweaks for the marketplace listing (short blurb ~150 chars), drop them here and I'll iterate quickly. :white_check_mark:
